json_schema.title: file.ucomment
json_schema.description: Uncomment specified commented lines in a file

path.ui:title: Path
path.ui:description: The full path to the file to be edited

regex.ui:title: Regex
regex.ui:description: A regular expression used to find the lines that are to be uncommented. This regex should not include the comment character

char.ui:title: Char
char.ui:description: The character to remove in order to uncomment a line

backup.ui:title: Backup file extension
backup.ui:description: The file will be backed up before edit with this file extension
